title: Implement contradiction detection and resolution
description:
Create chatbot/consolidation/contradiction.py.

Implement a ContradictionResolver class that detects and resolves contradictions in memory:
- Accept two MemoryEntry records and return a ContradictionResult with fields: has_contradiction (bool), resolution (Optional[str] describing the resolved fact), confidence (float 0-1), and contradictory_facts (list[str] of the conflicting statements).
- Use a strict comparator (rule-based) for deterministic low-level contradiction checking: identical subject with conflicting values, temporal contradictions (event A before event B but timestamps say otherwise), preference reversals.
- Use the LLM Provider interface for ambiguous cases where rule-based comparison cannot resolve the contradiction; inject the provider through the constructor.
- The resolver must be idempotent: the same pair of entries always produces the same ContradictionResult.
- Handle edge cases: one or both entries being None, empty content, identical entries (should return has_contradiction=False).
